newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks end little changed in quiet trading.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks end little changed in quiet trading.

text.p: Caracas stocks on Thursday ended little changed in quiet trading, largely unaffected by the government's successful sale of Banco de Venezuela and Banco Consolidado, traders said.
"The market was very stable, trade was light and nothing really moved stocks today," said Cavelba broker Harold Cuellar.
The bolsa's leading index edged ahead 0.24 percent to close at 6,245.38 points, as 18 stocks rose, 13 fell and nine closed unchanged.

Fogade, the National State Deposits Guarantee Fund, sold a 90 percent of Banco de Venezuela to Spain's Banco Santander for $338.4 million and an 80 percent share in Banco Consolidado to Chilean financial group Infisa for $123.5 million.
On the stock exchange, a total of 22.6 million shares exchanged hands worth 2.6 billion bolivars ($5.5 million).
